ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. All readings recorded and compared to baseline.

ground_truth.node_text: Attach a triaxial accelerometer to the spindle nose using a flat washer stud or epoxy mount with the sensor axes aligned to the machine X, Y, and Z axes. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder and record the root mean square vibration velocity in each axis. Repeat the measurement at the maximum rated speed and compare all six readings against the baseline vibration record from the previous service.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated non contact tachometer, direct the sensor beam at a reflective strip on the spindle nose. Command each of the four test speeds from the machine controller and record the actual speed displayed by the tachometer. Calculate the percentage speed error at each commanded speed and compare against the maximum speed accuracy tolerance in the spindle acceptance specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Tachometer readings taken at all four test speeds. Speed errors calculated and recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Using a calibrated non contact tachometer, direct the sensor beam at a reflective strip on the spindle nose. Command each of the four test speeds from the machine controller and record the actual speed displayed by the tachometer. Calculate the percentage speed error at each commanded speed and compare against the maximum speed accuracy tolerance in the spindle acceptance specification.

turns.utterance: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle. Zero the indicator and record the cold datum. Note the total thermal displacement at stabilization and compare against the stored thermal model parameters.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle before starting the warm up cycle. Zero the indicator and record the position as the cold datum. Run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes and record the indicator position at five minute intervals. Note the total thermal displacement at stabilisation and compare against the thermal growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal model parameters.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal growth test completed. All readings recorded at five-minute intervals and compared to model.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against a precision reference mandrel clamped in the spindle before starting the warm up cycle. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Fit a sealed test arbor with a coolant pressure gauge and flow indicator into the spindle taper. Start the coolant through spindle circuit at normal operating pressure. Read the pressure gauge at the taper outlet and observe the flow indicator for steady flow.

ground_truth.node_text: Fit a sealed test arbor with a coolant pressure gauge and flow indicator into the spindle taper. Start the coolant through spindle circuit at the normal operating pressure. Read the pressure gauge at the spindle taper outlet and compare against the minimum required coolant through spindle pressure. Observe the flow indicator for steady flow; pulsing or absent flow indicates a blocked spindle check valve or a failing coolant pump.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test arbor fitted and coolant circuit started. Pressure and flow readings taken.

ground_truth.node_text: Fit a sealed test arbor with a coolant pressure gauge and flow indicator into the spindle taper. Start the coolant through spindle circuit at the normal operating pressure. turns.utterance: Log all spindle measurements and update the maintenance record.
